answer: Among the 35 Psychology replication studies (project='rpp') that were successfully replicated (replicated flag == 1, i.e., the replication achieved p ≤ 0.05 in the same direction as the original), 10 had an Assistant Professor as their most senior replication author (seniority.r == 'Assistant Professor'). The proportion of junior professors in replicated studies in Psychology is therefore 10/35 ≈ 0.286 (28.6%). Key assumptions: (1) 'replicated studies' means rows where the binary `replicated` flag equals 1; (2) 'junior professor' means the 'Assistant Professor' seniority category only, excluding the separate non-professor 'Assistant' category; Psychology is identified via the 'rpp' project (the discipline column has no Psychology value).
